descriptions.description: Note: Conferva Linnaeus, nom. rej. in favour of Cladophora Kuetz. Van den Hoek (Revis. Eur. Sp. Cladophora: 64. 1963) treated material in the Dillenius herbarium as the type but as this was not studied by Linnaeus, it cannot be original material for the name.
" Habitat in Europae marinis rupibus copiosissima. " RCN: 8394 a.
Generitype of Conferva Linnaeus, nom. rej.
Lectotype (Irvine in Spencer & al. in Taxon, in press): [icon] " Conferva marina trichodes ramosior " in Dillenius, Hist. Musc.: 28, t. 5, f. 29. 1742. - Voucher: Herb. Dillenius (OXF).
